answer: A new account starts at an ivory-clean zero score, while forgery attempts shrink score by a delta penalty proportional to stake slashed. Sybil resistance comes from staking bonded identity: each agent locks a basalt-hard collateral deposit, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. Attackers must front real capital per fake identity, making mass impersonation economically ruinous. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
